api:
<PhasePortrait field={|x: f64, y: f64| (y, -x - 0.3 * y)} starts={vec![(2., 0.), (0., 2.)]} x_range={(-3., 3.)} y_range={(-3., 3.)} />
PropTypeDefault
fieldFn(f64, f64) -> (f64, f64): (dx/dt, dy/dt) at (x, y)required
startsVec<(f64, f64)>: one trajectory from eachrequired
x_range, y_range(f64, f64)required
durationf64: time to follow each trajectory10.
stepf64: the integration step0.01
arrowsusize: direction arrows per side of the grid15
x_label, y_labeltext"x", "y"
colorcolour of the direction arrowsthe first series colour
legend, tooltip, class

Trajectories are solved with fourth-order Runge–Kutta and stop once they are well outside the ranges.

examples.title: Damped pendulum
examples.description: Direction field and trajectories spiralling into rest.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn damped() {
    rsx! {
        <PhasePortrait
            field={pendulum}
            starts={vec![(-3., 2.5), (2.5, 0.), (0.5, 2.), (-1.5, -2.)]}
            x_range={(-4., 4.)}
            y_range={(-3., 3.)}
            duration={30.}
            x_label="θ"
            y_label="ω"
            class="h-80"
        />
    }
}

examples.title: Lotka–Volterra
examples.description: Closed orbits of predator and prey populations.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn predator_prey() {
    rsx! {
        <PhasePortrait
            field={|x: f64, y: f64| (x * (1. - 0.5 * y), y * (0.5 * x - 1.))}
            starts={vec![(1., 0.5), (2., 1.), (3., 2.)]}
            x_range={(0., 6.)}
            y_range={(0., 5.)}
            duration={20.}
            x_label="Prey"
            y_label="Predators"
            color={rgb(0xd20f39)}
            class="h-80"
        />
    }
}

examples.title: Undamped pendulum
examples.description: Closed orbits around the stable point.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn undamped() {
    rsx! {
        <PhasePortrait
            field={|x: f64, y: f64| (y, -x.sin())}
            starts={vec![(0.5, 0.), (1.5, 0.), (2.5, 0.), (0., 2.5)]}
            x_range={(-4., 4.)}
            y_range={(-3., 3.)}
            duration={20.}
            x_label="θ"
            y_label="ω"
            class="h-80"
        />
    }
}

examples.title: Van der Pol oscillator
examples.description: Trajectories from inside and outside converge on a limit cycle.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn van_der_pol() {
    rsx! {
        <PhasePortrait
            field={|x: f64, y: f64| (y, 1.5 * (1. - x * x) * y - x)}
            starts={vec![(0.1, 0.), (3., 3.), (-3., -2.)]}
            x_range={(-4., 4.)}
            y_range={(-5., 5.)}
            duration={20.}
            color={rgb(0x8839ef)}
            class="h-80"
        />
    }
}

examples.title: Saddle point
examples.description: Trajectories approach along one axis and leave along the other.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn saddle() {
    rsx! {
        <PhasePortrait
            field={|x: f64, y: f64| (x, -y)}
            starts={vec![(0.1, 2.), (-0.1, 2.), (0.1, -2.), (-0.1, -2.), (2., 0.1), (-2., 0.1)]}
            x_range={(-3., 3.)}
            y_range={(-3., 3.)}
            duration={3.}
            color={rgb(0xfe640b)}
            class="h-80"
        />
    }
}

examples.title: Stable spiral
examples.description: A linear system spiralling into the origin.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn stable_spiral() {
    rsx! {
        <PhasePortrait
            field={|x: f64, y: f64| (-0.2 * x + y, -x - 0.2 * y)}
            starts={vec![(3., 0.), (-2., 2.)]}
            x_range={(-4., 4.)}
            y_range={(-4., 4.)}
            duration={25.}
            color={rgb(0x179299)}
            class="h-80"
        />
    }
}

examples.title: Fine integration step
